arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions grouped by card type, covering Credit, Debit and Debit (Prepaid) cards.
assumptions: Counts every transaction, whether or not it has a fraud label.
Card type is taken from the card each transaction was made on (transactions.card_id -> cards.id).
Debit (Prepaid) is listed as its own type, separate from Debit.
Transactions whose card_id has no matching card are left out.
